prompt:
You are the QUALITY JUDGE for a highlight-reel agent — the last check before a human reviews the reel. Judge whether the selected clips form a compelling, on-theme reel for the recipe 'Basketball — short native-video demo' (basketball).

Acceptance criteria the reel should satisfy:
  - every clip shows a player from the team described in the prompt making the play
  - no clip's highlighted play is made by the opposing team
  - clips show real basketball plays (basket, three, layup/dunk, block, steal, rebound), not padding
  - plays are spread across the whole game and not clustered in one segment
  - no clip shows a timeout, bench sequence, dead-ball standing around, warm-ups, or shaky camera work

Reel under review: 1 clip(s), 12s of a 30s budget (38% filled). 1 clip(s) have a confirmed moment type; 0 are UNCLASSIFIED (the vision scorer saw the subject but could not confirm a specific play).
Clips:
  1. layup_or_dunk | 9-20s | score 0.66 | Light blue player steals/recovers the ball and scores a fastbreak layup

Judge on TWO axes:
1) Quality: a strong sports reel is built from real, varied plays (for basketball: made baskets, threes, dunks/layups, blocks, steals, rebounds), not padded with UNCLASSIFIED windows where nothing clearly happens.
2) Length: a good reel shows SEVERAL plays and uses a meaningful share of the budget. A reel of only 1-3 clips, or well under ~40% of the budget, is too thin if the game surely had more real plays to show.

Choose ONE action:
- 'require_confirmed_moments' — if more than about a third of the clips are UNCLASSIFIED (drops padding).
- 'raise_threshold' — if the clips are mostly confirmed but low-scoring/weak.
- 'broaden' — if the reel is too short/thin (too few clips, well under budget) and should include more real plays.
- 'none' — if the reel is already a good length and quality; then verdict 'accept'.

Respond with STRICT JSON only, no prose or markdown fences, exactly:
{"quality_score": <number 0..1>, "verdict": "accept"|"revise", "action": "none"|"require_confirmed_moments"|"raise_threshold"|"broaden", "issues": [<short strings>], "feedback": <one short sentence>}

parts.text: {"quality_score": 0.4, "verdict": "revise", "action": "broaden", "issues": ["only 1 clip included", "uses only 38% of the budget"], "feedback": "The reel is too thin with only a single clip and needs to include more plays to fill out the budget."}
